prompts: 短答1：指出最多三个与你的兴趣/目标最契合的学术领域（从官网列表中选）

Short takes（200 字符以内，约 35 词）①如果可以教任意一门大学课程/写一本书/创作任意原创艺术品，你会做什么？②你希望在大学期间成长或发展的自身的一个方面是什么？③有什么关于你、申请其他任何地方都没有体现的？
Essay（400 词以内，三选一）①回顾一次你与持相反观点者讨论重要议题的经历，为什么这次经历有意义？②回顾你所属并感到联结的一个社群，为什么这个社群对你重要（社群可自行定义）？③回顾你个人经历中能丰富大学社区的一个元素，它如何塑造了你？

prompts: 学术题（A.B. 学位或未定专业者）：As a research institution that also prides itself on its liberal arts curriculum, Princeton allows students to explore areas across the humanities and the arts, the natural sciences, and the social sciences. What academic areas most pique your curiosity, and how do the programs offered at Princeton suit your particular interests?（250 词以内）

学术题（B.S.E. 学位申请者）：Please describe why you are interested in studying engineering at Princeton. Include any of your experiences in or exposure to engineering, and how you think the programs offered at the University suit your particular interests.（250 词以内）

Your Voice 1：Princeton values community and encourages students, faculty, staff and leadership to engage in respectful conversations that can expand their perspectives and challenge their ideas and beliefs... how has your lived experience shaped you?（400-500 词）
Your Voice 2：Princeton has a longstanding commitment to understanding our responsibility to society through service and civic engagement. How does your own story intersect with these ideals?（250 词以内）
More About You（各 50 词以内）：①What is a new skill you would like to learn in college? ②What brings you joy? ③What song represents the soundtrack of your life at this moment?
另需单独提交 Graded Written Paper（评分过的书面作业，建议英语/历史科目）
supplements.word_limit: 学术题 250 词；Your Voice 1 = 400-500 词；Your Voice 2 = 250 词；More About You 每题 50 词以内

rowing_recruiting.process: 官网公布的分流标准与流程：普林斯顿同时设有世界级重量级与轻量级赛艇队，两队列均全国排名并持续输送 U23/国家队/奥运选手；不确定适配项目者可同时填写两个问卷或先邮件联系教练；体重 >170 lbs/77 kg（或不确定）→ 填重量级问卷；体重 ≤169 lbs/77 kg → 填轻量级问卷；舵手（coxswain）建议两份问卷都填。项目定位：以学术+高强度竞技为目标、IRA 全国锦标赛为竞技平台

prompts: 1. List the titles of texts, resources and outlets that have contributed to your intellectual development outside of academic courses...（100 词以内，逗号/分号分隔的清单）

2. Tell us about an aspect of your life so far or your lived experience that is important to you, and describe how it has shaped the way you would learn from and contribute to Columbia's multidimensional and collaborative environment.（150 词以内）

3. At Columbia, students representing a wide range of perspectives are invited to live and learn together... Please describe a time when you did not agree with someone and discuss how you engaged with them and what you took away from the interaction.（150 词以内）

4. In college/university, students are often challenged in ways that they could not anticipate. Please describe a situation in which you have navigated through adversity and discuss how you changed as a result.（150 词以内）
5. Why are you interested in attending Columbia University?（150 词以内）
6. What attracts you to your preferred areas of study at Columbia College or Columbia Engineering?（150 词以内）
另需提交 Common App / Coalition 个人陈述（Personal Essay）
